headline_marked: 12 injured as [[rumour of detainee's death sparks attack]] on Barishal police station
headline: 12 injured as rumour of detainee's death sparks attack on Barishal police station
summary: Over 100 people marched to Agailjhara Police Station after false reports that a man in custody had died, leading to clashes with police.
details: A rumour regarding the alleged death of a detainee triggered an attack on the Agailjhara Police Station in Barishal today, leaving 12 people injured, including five police personnel.
The incident occurred around 4:00 pm, prompting authorities to deploy additional forces to bring the situation under control.

The detainee, 26-year-old Riaz Fakir, was arrested on Wednesday evening in a theft case and faced multiple charges including narcotics. While in custody, he reportedly struck his own head repeatedly and fell ill.
He was transferred to the Agailjhara Upazila Health Complex and later referred to Sher-e-Bangla Medical College Hospital for treatment.
Rumours spread that Riaz had died in custody, which sparked anger among locals. More than a hundred people marched to the police station and attacked it.
Assistant Sub-Inspector Abdul Halim suffered serious injuries and was admitted to Sher-e-Bangla Medical College Hospital.
Police used batons to disperse the crowd, resulting in injuries to Riaz's mother, sister, and a relative, along with three others.
While Riaz's parents alleged police assault, police denied the claim, citing CCTV footage that showed the detainee injuring himself inside the lock-up.
Barishal Superintendent of Police AZM Mostafizur Rahman confirmed that the CCTV footage proves the detainee hit his own head, and one of the injured policemen is in critical condition.
caption:
12 people, including 5 police officers, injured after a false rumour of a detainee's death sparked a violent attack on a police station in Barishal.

A rumour regarding the alleged death of a detainee triggered an attack on the Agailjhara Police Station in Barishal today, leaving 12 people injured, including five police personnel.

The incident occurred around 4:00 pm, prompting authorities to deploy additional forces to bring the situation under control.

The detainee, 26-year-old Riaz Fakir, was arrested on Wednesday evening in a theft case and faced multiple charges including narcotics. While in custody, he reportedly struck his own head repeatedly and fell ill.

He was transferred to the Agailjhara Upazila Health Complex and later referred to Sher-e-Bangla Medical College Hospital for treatment.

Rumours spread that Riaz had died in custody, which sparked anger among locals. More than a hundred people marched to the police station and attacked it.

Assistant Sub-Inspector Abdul Halim suffered serious injuries and was admitted to Sher-e-Bangla Medical College Hospital.

Police used batons to disperse the crowd, resulting in injuries to Riaz's mother, sister, and a relative, along with three others.

While Riaz's parents alleged police assault, police denied the claim, citing CCTV footage that showed the detainee injuring himself inside the lock-up.

Barishal Superintendent of Police AZM Mostafizur Rahman confirmed that the CCTV footage proves the detainee hit his own head, and one of the injured policemen is in critical condition.

headline_marked: Investigation launched after [[primary scholarship results leaked]]
headline: Investigation launched after primary scholarship results leaked
summary: A probe committee has been formed following the unauthorized release of primary scholarship exam results.
details: The results of the primary scholarship examinations have been leaked, sparking concern over the integrity of the examination process.
Authorities have responded by forming an investigation committee to determine how the leak occurred and who was responsible.
Earlier, reports indicated that the results had not been officially published due to alleged technical glitches.
The investigation aims to ensure that the scholarship process remains fair and transparent for all students involved.
caption:
Primary scholarship results leaked! An investigation committee has been formed to find the out the truth.

The results of the primary scholarship examinations have been leaked, sparking concern over the integrity of the examination process.

Authorities have responded by forming an investigation committee to determine how the leak occurred and who was responsible.

Earlier, reports indicated that the results had not been officially published due to alleged technical glitches.

The investigation aims to ensure that the scholarship process remains fair and transparent for all students involved.
